delivered.reranker_wiring: LocalCrossEncoderReranker instantiated in RagRuntimeIntegration composition root; injected ONLY at RagOrchestrator post-fusion evidence surface (rerank_evidence). HybridRetriever deliberately left unparametrized to prevent double-rerank of the same candidates.
delivered.cuda_load_point: CrossEncoder device chosen via GpuCoordinator.acquire(1536MB, priority=inference, timeout=GPTBRIDGE_RAG_RERANKER_GPU_TIMEOUT_S/15s); torch.cuda.is_available() checked first; any failure degrades to CPU (fail-soft, mirrors NativeTransformerEngine pattern).
delivered.resource_admission: ModelResourceManager.request_load(ModelRole.RERANKER, ram_mb=2560); Retention.ON_DEMAND; release() on load failure.
delivered.local_only: sentence_transformers.CrossEncoder(local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=False); no network fetch on retrieval hot path.
delivered.fallback: Any denial/load/predict failure returns input order unchanged with meta.reranker_applied=False and reason; callers fall back to RRF/fused order.

rulings.process_registry: NOT APPLICABLE — ProcessRegistry (star-process-registry/v1) tracks OS processes by PID/executable/ppid with liveness reconciliation. The reranker is an in-process model object; registering it would fabricate a process record and violate is_owned semantics. Resource ownership is already recorded via ModelResourceManager ledger (model-resource-ledger.jsonl).
rulings.boot_autostart: NO AUTOSTART — per Codex A586/A587 RAG is capability-critical not boot-critical; composition root is lazy (ensure_rag_cag_started). Reranker model additionally lazy-loads on first predict call. Ruling: on-demand only, consistent with ModelRole.RERANKER=ON_DEMAND.
